intended_object: The pairing functor ⟨F, G⟩ : A ⥤ B × C of two functors F : A ⥤ B and G : A ⥤ C with a common source, sending a ↦ (F a, G a) and f ↦ (F f, G f). This is the universal map into the product in Cat. Inferred from the docstring and the body.
explanation: The body is exactly the pairing functor: objects go to (F.obj a, G.obj a) and morphisms to F.map f ×ₘ G.map f, with the functor laws discharged automatically. It is stated for arbitrary categories and universe levels, which is its natural generality. It is itself the Mathlib definition (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Products/Basic.lean) and has no separate duplicate; it differs from Functor.prod, which takes functors with different sources and gives a functor A × C ⥤ B × D.
